---
name: Cannon idea
about: Suggest a new orbital cannon (or a new arsenal payload or pattern)
title: "[Idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Name**
What should it be called?

**What does it do?**
Describe what happens when it lands. Who does it affect, how long does it last, and does it break blocks?

**Warning**
What should players see or hear before it hits? (Optional.)

**Settings**
What should server owners be able to change in its config? For example radius, damage or duration.

**Tier and menu tab**
Common, rare, epic or legendary? Which tab: explosives, beams, weapons, space, weather, terrain, mobs,
control, curses, buffs, utility, minigames or fun?

**Is it like an existing cannon?**
Check [CANNONS.md](https://github.com/NeonWardonmc/mega-orbitals/blob/main/CANNONS.md). If it's close to one, say how yours is different.
